pinned.message:
Use attackmap.sdk.fs walker; fix absolute-path skip-dir bug (#4)

Replace the private rglob + SKIP_DIRS walk in detect() and analyze() with
attackmap.sdk.iter_repo_files, read files with read_source, and use the
SDK rel/line_of helpers. Skip dirs are now matched only inside the repo,
symlinks out of the repo are not followed, and unreadable files no longer
raise. detect() stops at the first .py file.

Lower priority 15 -> 10 so the plugin runs before the built-in python-web
analyzer (20) under core's (priority, name) ordering.

Refs mlaify/AttackMap#253
Refs mlaify/AttackMap#221

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

candidate.message:
Resolve Django include() prefixes; add aiohttp RouteTableDef, Litestar controllers, Tornado, Sanic @route (#9)

* Resolve Django include() prefixes; add RouteTableDef, Litestar controllers, Tornado, Sanic @route

Django URLconfs and DRF router modules are now read with ast and the
include() graph is walked from the root URLconfs, so child routes carry
their parent prefix (dotted modules, imported modules, (patterns, app)
tuples, inline/local lists, re_path/url, patterns(), router.urls mounts
across modules). path("") is emitted as "/", a resolved include() line is
no longer a route, and an unresolvable one keeps its prefix. The resolver
is bounded (depth, mounts per list, steps, routes) and stops on cycles;
an unparseable file keeps the regex fallback.

Also adds aiohttp web.RouteTableDef decorators and add_route/add_view,
Litestar handlers at any indentation with Controller.path and Router
prefixes (guards -> auth required, exclude_from_auth -> anonymous),
Tornado URLSpecs paired with handler methods (@authenticated -> required),
Sanic @route(methods=...) / @websocket, and Django URLconf auth wrappers
(login_required(view) etc.) for Route.auth.

Closes #2

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Bound and harden the route resolvers (python#9 review)

- Django pattern lists are unions with per-list/per-file entry caps, so
  `urlpatterns = urlpatterns + urlpatterns` can't double, and
  reassignments, if/else / try/except branches and unknown wrappers
  (`decorate_urlpatterns(urlpatterns, ...)`) no longer drop routes.
- Router registrations count against the step budget, are capped per
  router, and a router mounted twice at the same prefix is walked once.
- Absolute include anchors come from an indexed set of manage.py dirs,
  cached per directory, instead of scanning every project dir.
- Sanic: `methods=[HTTPMethod.DELETE]` enums, and `//` collapsed like core.
- Tornado: handlers that subclass RequestHandler through project base
  classes are resolved (bounded).
- Litestar: a handler mounted twice with conflicting auth is `unknown`.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Never keep first-seen auth when a route is emitted with conflicting auth

The union semantics for Django pattern lists (18ca869) can emit the same
path twice from a reassigned or if/else `urlpatterns`, once guarded and
once not. With first-wins dedup the guarded version could win and report
`required`. `_append_unique_route` now downgrades a (path, method, file)
seen with different auth values to `unknown` and clears its guards and
evidence, for every extractor in the plugin.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
